006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IArrayItem;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Use to visit the major types of items.
017 */
018public interface IItemVisitor {
019  /**
020   * Visit the array item instance.
021   *
022   * @param array
023   *          the instance to visit
024   */
025  void visit(@NonNull IArrayItem<?> array);
026
027  /**
028   * Visit the map item instance.
029   *
030   * @param map
031   *          the instance to visit
032   */
033  void visit(@NonNull IMapItem<?> map);
034
035  /**
036   * Visit the node item instance.
037   *
038   * @param node
039   *          the instance to visit
040   */
041  void visit(@NonNull INodeItem node);
042
043  /**
044   * Visit the atomic item instance.
045   *
046   * @param item
047   *          the instance to visit
048   */
049  void visit(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item);
050
051  /**
052   * Visit the function item instance.
053   *
054   * @param function
055   *          the instance to visit
056   */
057  void visit(@NonNull IFunction function);
058}
